name: TEAM DENTIST ESCAPE! (TEAMWORK OBBY)
desc:
(Private servers are free!)

GET UP!!! Mom has just dropped us off to have our teeth examined by MR. MEANIE, the most EVIL dentist to EVER live!!! There's no way this place is safe 😨, quick find a friend to escape with and let's get out of here!

If you have fun playing this obby please thumbs-up 👍 and favorite ⭐ to support the game. Thank you so much for playing!!!
